# ex: assigneeType via return statement in function
ex {
	var x int
	F(x) -> G(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int) int { return x }
func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

func H() int {
	return F(1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@
 func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

 func H() int {
-	return F(1)
+	return G(1)
 }
